chosen.title: a woman working with her laptop
chosen.faces: side profile, looking at screen (not camera)
chosen.why: Reads as 'office work' the instant it appears: natural window light, laptop, blazer, plant, steady typing. Side profile, no camera-aware acting, muted natural palette that will grade down easily. At 1.2s both hands are mid-keystroke and framing is clean; typing continues well past the 0.7s cut.

alternates.why: Extreme close-up of a man's hands typing on a laptop (suit cuff, wood desk). Reads 'typing' instantly, no face, neutral color. Less office context than 1788 and slightly more generic-stock.

Top-down meeting table with three people and printed charts; man reaching across to point at a chart around 1.0s. Reads 'meeting' immediately. Harsher sun beams / higher contrast than the brief's tone.

notes: Sheets: typing keyboard, office typing, busy office, business meeting. Downloaded 4827, 1788, 4809, 39852, 42662. 39852 is vertical 1080x1920 and was disqualified. 42662 (top-down woman's hands on laptop) is usable but only 5.0s and drifts soft-focus; left in candidates but not listed as an alternate. Word '화' read as a weekday marker (화요일) -> ordinary office workday image.
